newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - June 6.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - June 6.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 35.63 points to 7,305.29 as Wall Street approached Friday's widely awaited May jobs report with surprising confidence.

* National Development Planning Minister Ginanjar Kartasasmita said on Thursday that Indonesia was expecting about $5 billion in foreign aid this year from the Consultative Group for Indonesia (CGI), which meets in Japan in July.
* On Thursday, the Jakarta Composite Index closed 1.56 points lower at 691.98 points on sustained profit-taking in selected blue chips, brokers said.
* On Friday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,429.00/29.50 at 0215 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,429.75/30.50.

* Blue chip Bank Negara Indonesia on an announcement on Thursday that it intends to purchase shares owned by Indonesia's central bank, Bank Indonesia, in N.V. De Indonesische Overzeese Bank (Indover) in Amsterdam.

* Conglomerate Bimantara Citra after it signed an agreement on Thursday to set up a joint venture with Hyundai Motor Corp to produce sedan and commercial car in Indonesia. Bimantara director Kadir Assegaff said its first quarter net profit was 17 percent higher than the same 1996 period.
* Engineering firm Bukaka Teknik Utama after it said it posted a 1996 net profit of 45.44 billion rupiah, compared with 28.50 billion rupiah in 1995.

* PT Indonesia Satellite (Indosat) on reports that it launched on Thursday the Global Express Phone-7 service or the Inmarsat Mini-M, a new international call service using International Maritime Satellite's (Inmarsat) network.
* Adhesive producer Kurnia Kapuas Utama on market talk that an affiliate company would take a controlling stake in the firm.
* Property firm Surya Semesta Internusa on continued market talk of the possible entry of a local conglomerate or foreign investor into the firm.
* Life insurance Lippo Life following its proposed rights issue which is subject to shareholders approval at its extraordinary shareholders' meeting on June 27.
